verdict.rationale: An AI-assistant SaaS could plausibly publish an API spec, so the axis applies, but no OpenAPI or equivalent spec is documented and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file is a documentation index, not an API spec. The MCP pages describe Lindy consuming other servers' tools, not exposing its own spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
